title: Saint Lucia ROCIP Business Registry Scraper

query.title: Company/business name, number, or surname
query.description: A company/business name (or partial name), registration number, or (in Directors/Shareholders mode) a surname to search for.

queries.title: Names, numbers, or surnames
queries.description: Multiple names/numbers/surnames to search for in one run. Combined with 'query' if both are set.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.description: Entities: search by company/business name or registration number. Directors: search by a director's surname. Shareholders: search by a shareholder's surname or corporate name (in recon this mode consistently returned zero matches -- see README -- shareholder data does not appear to be populated in this index).

maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max results per query
maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum number of matched records to return per search query. Note: the registry's own API caps broad queries at 50 rows with no pagination available -- this only trims down, it cannot retrieve more than the server returns.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent workers
maxConcurrency.description: How many searches to run in parallel.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy configuration. Residential is on by default.
